# DNA OS

> Public references for DNA OS routes, integration boundaries, and verified connection status.

## Public references
- [System map](https://dnaos.dev/system-map.md): production services, source boundaries, and evidence limits.
- [API and connection reference](https://dnaos.dev/api-reference.md): public endpoint status and developer access boundaries.
- [Machine-readable endpoint status](https://dnaos.dev/api-status.json): method, path, status, observation time, and verification limits.
- [Machine-readable system map](https://dnaos.dev/system-map.json): services, source files, and dated deployment observations.
- [AI reference package](https://dnaos.dev/system-map-ai.zip): downloadable static reference files.
- [Brand asset usage](https://dnaos.dev/assets/brand/dna-os/v1/README.md): DNA OS-owned brand files and usage notes.

## Authentication
- [Sign in](https://dnaos.dev/login): browser-based email OTP entry.
- [Authentication route map](https://github.com/t23598788-oss/DNAOS/blob/main/docs/DNA_OS_AUTH_ROUTE_MAP_2026-11-23.md): source, production observations, and release gates.

## Status rules
- A route is labelled **Live** only when the exact method and path has a dated production observation.
- A source declaration is not proof of a deployed route or connected provider account.
- The public developer API, self-service API keys, rate limits, sandbox, and LINE/n8n quickstarts are not published at this time.
- General Googlebot is allowed by the observed robots.txt wildcard; Google-Extended and several AI fetcher tokens are explicitly disallowed. The AI index does not override crawler policy.
